note: EXPERIMENTAL thin field-plugin submodule of entity_reference_override. Provides the field type entity_reference_override_revisions ('Entity reference revisions w/custom text', class Drupal\entity_reference_override_revisions\Plugin\Field\FieldType\EntityReferenceOverrideRevisions, extends entity_reference_revisions' EntityReferenceRevisionsItem), adding ONE override column (varchar 255; NO override_format) and field setting override_label. default_widget entity_reference_override_revisions_autocomplete; default_formatter reuses the parent module's entity_reference_override_label. No config form, no permissions, no services. Depends on entity_reference_override + entity_reference_revisions. Medium introspects the live field-type plugin definition (cheap plugin.manager.field.field_type read). Hard has the agent write the field-storage-creation CODE into a deletable scratch file under web/sites/default/ (entity_reference_override_revisions_field.eval.php) which verify greps and reset deletes -- scratch-file authoring is used because on THIS shared site attaching field/display config for this type is very slow (canvas reacts to field definitions) and 'drush cr' fatals in an unrelated canvas/ui_patterns collision. Facts grounded in src/Plugin/Field/FieldType/EntityReferenceOverrideRevisions.php and src/Plugin/Field/FieldWidget/.

evals.prompt: I use Entity Reference Revisions (e.g. with Paragraphs) and want a per-reference custom title. Which field type does the entity_reference_override_revisions submodule add, and what does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It adds the field type entity_reference_override_revisions ('Entity reference revisions w/custom text'), a subclass of Entity Reference Revisions' EntityReferenceRevisionsItem, with an extra 'override' text column for overriding the referenced revision's title.

evals.prompt: For the entity_reference_override_revisions field type, which formatter is used by default to apply the override, and does it support a text-format (WYSIWYG) override like the base entity_reference_override field?
evals.expected_output: Its default_formatter is the parent module's entity_reference_override_label (so the same override_action modes apply). Unlike the base entity_reference_override type it has NO override_format setting -- the override is plain text only (override column is varchar 255).

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the field-type plugin definitions and tell me the PHP class implementing entity_reference_override_revisions and its default formatter.
evals.expected_output: Class Drupal\entity_reference_override_revisions\Plugin\Field\FieldType\EntityReferenceOverrideRevisions; default_formatter entity_reference_override_label; default_widget entity_reference_override_revisions_autocomplete. Discoverable with: drush php:eval "var_export(\Drupal::service('plugin.manager.field.field_type')->getDefinition('entity_reference_override_revisions'));".

evals.prompt: Write PHP that defines a field storage of type entity_reference_override_revisions on the node entity. To avoid mutating this shared site's field definitions, write the code into the scratch file web/sites/default/entity_reference_override_revisions_field.eval.php (create it). It must create a FieldStorageConfig whose type is entity_reference_override_revisions.
